scope: Elbow H + forearm roll R + wrist W. Same meshes in installed arm and independent specimens. Shoulder/clavicle retention not qualified.

user_feedback.friction: Initially adequate, loses resistance after about ten cycles
user_feedback.issue: User saw screw tip retract and reappear after retightening; strong evidence of back-out with ordinary nuts and no locking

design_changes: Closed axial hex pockets, seven NL3, fourteen additional W4 spacer washers, seven W3 .5 replacing RW3 .8. Existing shoulder screws and moving parts retained.
